answer: Like water sinking through karst, fake identities drain away without pooling power. Agents stake a bonded deposit to register, and each identity's influence is weighted by a slow-decaying reputation rooted in verified peer attestations, so spinning up thousands of fresh wallets yields a ripple of near-zero weight rather than a flood. Honest newcomers still earn standing by completing tasks in the open meadow of the marketplace, where every attestation is public and costly to fake. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
